categories.title: Divine Beast
categories.info: Divine Beasts are large animals-shaped dungeons, and are part of Breath of the Wild's main quest.

categories.title: Goddess Statue
categories.info: Goddess Statues can be gifted 4 Spirit Orbs in exchange for either a Stamina Vessel or a Heart Container.

categories.title: Great Fairy
categories.info: Great Fairies require a one-time cost to unlock, after which they can enhance Link's equipment.
categories.template:
**For the first Great Fairy:**
- Costs 100 Rupees
- Enhances up to ★

**For the second Great Fairy:**
- Costs 500 Rupees
- Enhances up to ★★

**For the third Great Fairy:**
- Costs 1,000 Rupees
- Enhances up to ★★★

**For the fourth Great Fairy:**
- Costs 10,000 Rupees
- Enhances up to ★★★★

categories.title: Landmark
categories.info: Locations are various places within Hyrule. To obtain 100% completion, Link must visit some of them, as indicated.

categories.title: Raft
categories.info: Rafts allow Link to cross bodies of water without swimming, conserving stamina and avoiding harmful effects.
categories.template: **How to use:** Swing a Korok Leaf at the sail to generate wind and move the raft. Hold your attack for a greater burst of wind.

categories.title: Sheikah Tower
categories.info: Sheikah Towers can be activated by climbing them. Once active, they reveal their associated region on Link's map.

categories.title: Shrine
categories.info: Shrines are small dungeons scattered through Hyrule. Completing one unlocks a Fast Travel point and grants a Spirit Orb.

categories.title: Village
categories.info: Villages regroup a lot of NPCs, shops and inns.

categories.title: Armor Shop
categories.info: Armor Stores sell a variety of clothing and armor. They restock after spending at least 24 hours in a different region.

categories.title: Dye Shop
categories.info: The Dye Shop will dye all of Link's currently worn clothes, at the price of 20 Rupees and 5 valid ingredients for the chosen color.

categories.title: Fang and Bone
categories.info: After meeting [Kilton](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247441), Fang and Bone become available. Only open at night, this shop requires trading monster parts for Mon, which can then be used to purchase gear. See Kilton for other locations.

categories.title: General Store
categories.info: General Stores sell a variety of materials and goods. They restock after spending at least 24 hours in a different region (except for arrows, which only restock if you have less than 50 of that type).

categories.title: Hestu
categories.info: After completing [The Priceless Maracas](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247174), Hestu will expand Link's weapon, bow and shield inventory in exchange for Korok Seeds.
categories.template:
**Location:** ??  
**Expansions:**
_Weapon Stash:_ Can be expanded 11 times, for a maximum of 19 slots.  
_Costs:_ 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 12, 17, 25, 35, 45, 55

_Bow Stash:_ Can be expanded 8 times, for a maximum of 13 slots.  
_Costs:_ 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 12, 17, 25

_Shield Stash:_ Can be expanded 16 times, for a maximum of 20 slots.  
_Costs:_ 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 10, 10, 10, 10, 10, 15, 15, 15, 15, 15, 20

categories.title: Inn
categories.info: Inns allow Link to rest, recovering his Health. Most inns offer different sleep alternatives, granting additional bonuses.

categories.title: Jewelry Shop
categories.info: Jewelry Shops sell gem-based headgear.

categories.title: Mini-Game
categories.info: Mini-Games are repeatable challenges, which Link can undertake for prizes. The better his performance, the better the prize.

categories.title: Stable
categories.info:
All stables offer the following services:
- Horse registration - costs 20 Rupees, up to 5 registered horses. A registered horse can be whistled, tracked on the map, given a name and is given a bride and saddle to ride on.
- Rest - 20 Rupees for a regular bed, or 40 Rupees for a soft bed (grants 1 Temporary Heart)
- Merchants; see the description for the specific merchants available.

categories.title: Korok Seed
categories.info: Korok Seeds are hidden everywhere through Hyrule. After completing [The Priceless Maracas](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247174), bring Korok Seeds to [Hestu](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247173) to expand Link's inventory.

categories.title: Armor
categories.info: Equipment can be bought in shops or looted from chests. It can be upgraded at Great Fairies for greater armor bonuses. If part of a set, it also grants a set bonus once every piece is at least ★★.

categories.title: Arrow Chest
categories.info: Arrow Chests contain normal and elemental ammunition for Link's bows.

categories.title: Gem
categories.info: Gems are valuable materials mostly found in Ores. They can be sold for a high price or used to enhance armor.

categories.title: Shield
categories.info: Shields can be found in chests or dropped by enemies. They can be used a number of times equal to their Durability before breaking. Depending on Link's progress, a shield found in a chest may have modifiers or be scaled to a higher tier in its series.

categories.title: Weapon
categories.info: Weapons can be found in chests or dropped by enemies. They can be used a number of times equal to their Durability before breaking. Depending on Link's progress, a weapon found in a chest may have modifiers or be scaled to a higher tier in its series.

categories.title: Main Quest
categories.info: Main Quests are the way to completing the game

categories.title: Memory
categories.info: Memories appear after starting the [Captured Memories](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=248310) Main Quest. Interact with the glowing light.

categories.title: Shrine Quest
categories.info: Completing a Shrine Quest unlocks it's associated Shrine.

categories.title: Side Quest
categories.info: Side Quests are optional quests given by various inhabitants of Hyrule. Complete them for a variety of rewards.

categories.title: Enemy Camp
categories.info: Enemy camps contain a set number of enemies; defeat them all to unlock the chest. An [S] tag means that enemy scales with Link's progression.

categories.title: Guardian
categories.info: Guardians are mechanical enemies, commonly found within Shrines and Divine Beasts.

categories.title: Journal
categories.info: Journals can be read by Link to provide a wide variety of information, such as lore, recipes or hints towards quests.

categories.title: Unique Horse
categories.info: Unique horses are only capturable during their respective quest. They can thereafter be registered as normal horses.

categories.title: Zora Monument
categories.info: Zora Monuments tell the story of the Zora, and are part of the [Zora Stone Monuments](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-breath-of-the-wild/maps/hyrule?locationIds=247253) side quest.
